v.s: Lunox summons a rain of starlight upon nearby enemies, dealing 200( +110% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage). The starlight then returns to Lunox, each restoring 75( +30% Total Magic Power) HP to her. The HP restored is doubled when hitting enemy heroes.\nGrants one stack of (Power of Order) after use.
The best laning skill in early game. Start the attack with Chaos Assault, then deal damage and heal Lunox with Starlight Pulse, keeping her in Brilliance status all the time.

Lunox unleashes Chaos Energy at an enemy, dealing (Magic Damage) equal to 200( +120% Total Magic Power) plus 2.5% of the target's Max HP (1.5% of Max HP against Creeps).\nGrants one stack of (Power of Chaos) after use.

The attack-oriented skill in laning. Tap to release and it will lock on enemy within target area first. It shares cooldown with Starlight Pulse. You are suggested to use the skill to strike the first 2 attacks in laning.
When Lunox uses the power of Order and Chaos, she will deal 300( +150% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) to the targets along the way and slow them by 40% for 2s.

Lunox gets the ultimate skill in the Darkening status. When the ultimate skill is on, she could use Chaos Assault with no limit for 4s. Learning how to cast Chaos Assault as many as possible makes you a good Lunox user.\x3Cbr>Lunox gets the ultimate skill in Brilliance status. When the skill is on, Lunox is invincible for 3s. The extremely short cast time of the skill could help Lunox escape most directional skills if you are fast enough.

Lunox is twisted by the powers of Chaos and Order.\nWhen Lunox uses (Power of Order), she gains 1% Spell Vamp for every 1% (Magic Penetration).\nWhen Lunox uses (Power of Chaos), she gains 1% (Magic Penetration) for every 1% of Spell Vamp.
Chaos Assault is recommended when there’s advantage in attack, which grants magic PEN for higher damage dealt. Select Starlight Pulse in laning to boost double resist.
Unique Passive - Mana Spring: Regenerates 15% Max Mana every 10s.
Unique Passive - Mysticism: Getting a kill or assist on an enemy Minion will restore 4% Mana. (An assist occurs when a Minion dies within 2s after taking damage from the hero.)
Unique Passive - Magic: Dealing Magic Damage to enemy heroes will reduce their Magic Defense by 3-7 (scales with level) for 2s. Stacks up to 3 times.

Unique Passive - Recharge: Increases Magic Power by 5 after dealing Magic Damage (this effect stacks up to 6 times and can only gain 1 stack every 0.4s). When reaching full stacks, increases Magic Damage by 12% for 3s.
Unique Passive - Mystery: Gains 21%-35% extra Magic Power (scales with level).
Unique Passive - Guard: Gains a shield equal to 200% of Magic Power. The shield will regenerate 20s after being damaged, and grants 30 Movement Speed while it lasts.
